sources.title: GitHub - nv-tlabs/PiD: PiD: Fast and High-Resolution Latent Decoding ...
sources.snippet: TL;DR — PiD is a plug-and-play diffusion decoder that replaces VAE/RAE decoders, turning latent representations directly into super-resolved pixels in a single pass. Concise.Version.mp4 PiD reformulates the latent-to-pixel decoder as a conditional pixel-space diffusion model, unifying decoding and upsampling into a single generative module. It directly denoises in high-resolution pixel space ...

sources.snippet: PiD 1.5 qwenimage just got an NVFP4. First quantized decoder of this thing on HF. 2.61 GB → 1.09 GB. Drops in a stock UNETLoader. No custom loader. No core patches. No Blackwell tax - if your card runs the bf16, it runs this. Same seed, same latent, both builds. Faces, lettering, bokeh all hold at 100% crops. sources.snippet: PiD v1 fp8 is available only for Flux1-family 2k/2kto4k and Flux2-family 2k; Flux2 2kto4k, SD3, SDXL, and Qwen-Image must use bf16. PiD v1.5 supports bf16 and int8; its INT8 ConvRot diffusion model uses the FP8 Gemma text encoder.
